mechanical_checks.name: consumer_identity_exact_match
mechanical_checks.rule: consumer_universe_id and identity_bindings exact-match sealed constants

mechanical_checks.name: native_pair_key_to_pair_record_bijection
mechanical_checks.rule: every native_pair_key maps to exactly one pair_record key

mechanical_checks.name: retained_candidate_exactly_one_event
mechanical_checks.rule: every retained candidate key belongs to exactly one event under rho

mechanical_checks.name: emitted_row_count_reconciliation
mechanical_checks.rule: totals for native keys and emitted rows reconcile with evidence arrays

mechanical_checks.name: cross_event_candidate_splits_rejected
mechanical_checks.rule: same candidate key assigned to multiple events fails closed

mechanical_checks.name: overflow_counters_zero
mechanical_checks.rule: all relevant overflow_* counters equal zero

mechanical_checks.name: silent_truncation_impossible
mechanical_checks.rule: silent_truncation_possible must be false under the declared basis

mechanical_checks.name: capture_exposure_predicates
mechanical_checks.rule: require_candidate_exposure and bridge_attempt_count equals native candidate key count

mechanical_checks.name: claim_commit_label_excluded
mechanical_checks.rule: claim/commit/label fields do not participate in universe or membership

mechanical_checks.name: m0_m1_m2_identical_universe
mechanical_checks.rule: M0/M1/M2 consume identical event sets and C_e
